milestones.title: Theorem 19 — Exact Triangle
milestones.milestone_description: Exact Triangle on three $n\times n$ integer weight matrices with polynomially bounded entries can be decided deterministically in $O(n^{2.9983})$ word-RAM steps. This milestone is shared with the APSP mission. Theorem 21(a) supplies the reduction from integer 3SUM; together, these results yield the goal bound. Source: Alman–Vassilevska Williams, Theorems 19 and 21(a); accompanying EndStatement.lean, Theorem_19.
